verdict.rationale: Algolia's data-ingestion docs say Algolia 'keeps the schedule, the retries, and the transformations,' configured in the dashboard without code. That shows recurring scheduled data syncs, but scheduling is limited to ingestion. The CLI is positioned for scripts and CI workflows, so any other recurring automation would rely on an external scheduler. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of arbitrary jobs/workflows, documentation of schedule options (cron/intervals) and of scheduling via API/CLI/agent, independent or hands-on corroboration.
